human_feedback: WiLoR 2D is definitely better overall than MediaPipe; handles hands entering/leaving occlusion. MediaPipe bounces even when visible.
Primary interaction part masks looked worse than original.
Kineo works when present but randomly disappears; user suspected eyes not visible.
CLIP + Drop-DTW is only okay and misses many substeps.

agent_findings.subject: four-part reference
agent_findings.finding: The corrected focused static SAM3 reference retains the verified human frame-327 correction; the reviewed-seed SAM2 control is no longer the default interaction mask layer.

agent_findings.subject: Kineo NLF continuity
agent_findings.finding: Kineo gaps are attributed to sparse person-box detection and one-pass interpolation behavior, not to eye or HMD visibility; per-frame detection is tested separately.

agent_findings.subject: fine substep alignment
agent_findings.finding: The preserved 11-label Drop-DTW arm remains exploratory failure evidence: 3 of 9 checkpoint matches and 158-frame mean boundary error.
